full_page.content:
1937, March
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 172
Mar. 3 Philomena Simons - 55 - 3 operations on liver cancer - family asks for prayer.
Mrs. Carroll Rossel & Br .- in-law.
3 Mrs. Hughes - 58 - glucomaic eye ..... improving ... but ...
4 Bertha Waun - 41 - fears operation tuomer or cancer.
5 James G. Gleeson - 17 - in Wahjmega - very peculiar tuomer on or near brain. Mind perfect - in this condition 2 yrs. - Was ex- cellent musician - operation
6 Mary Louise Butler - 21 mo. - had been given up as hopeless - pneu- monia, emphysema, and intestinal flu - prayed for 3 weeks ago & En- rolled .... OK - or most so - enrolled To-day perpetual.
Page 173
Mar. 6 Francis McNamara - 62 - fearful asthma some weeks ago fell from ef- fects of it.
7 Mrs. Cath. Kempa - 41 - in Shirley Hospital, T.B. one lung gone and number of ribs; other operation threatened Beatrice Hook - 21 - nervous etc. Rosetta Gibson
8 Carry Fraley - 48 - eye trouble and serious intestinal adhesions - causing spasims etc .....
Mrs. Brewer - 42 of Bay City ....
Frank Maison - 27 - misunderstanding with a best friend & Estrange- ment to some one else. Enrolls To-night and promises perpet. and more frequent Com'n.
9 Winifred Kentner, 21 - very serious accident two yrs. ago - just escaped death ... girl friend at wheel -killed instantly. Now has very serious Kidney trouble so that ... "No doctor on earth can cure her" ...
Page 174 Mar. 9 Joseph Bejma - 48 - Harper Hospital - see July 28 & Dec. 27th last) thought to be dying last Sunday night - starving because of loss of tongue, has been able to receive Holy Communion and seems once more improving.
